name: Relay Content Pipeline — HITL Challenge (Free Edition)

parameters.content:
## 🎯 Relay Content Pipeline — Human-in-the-Loop (100% Free)

**Brief → Sofia (Strategy) → Marcus (Creative + Image Gen) → Taylor (QA) → Video Creation → Published Post**

Every stage: AI agent + human review form + feedback loop. Reviewers approve, revise (with notes), or reject.
💸 **All free:** Google Gemini (free tier) for AI, Pollinations.ai (no API key) for images, FFmpeg for video.
Brand context loaded once in Config — swap clients by editing one node.

### 💸 Free Setup Guide

**1. Google Gemini (AI — free)**
Go to aistudio.google.com → Get API Key
Paste it into each Gemini credential node.
Free tier: 15 requests/min, 1M tokens/day.

**2. Pollinations.ai (Images — free)**
No API key needed. Works via URL.
The HTTP Request node handles it.

**3. FFmpeg (Video — free)**
Self-hosted n8n: `apt install ffmpeg`
Mac: `brew install ffmpeg`
If FFmpeg isn't installed, the video
step is skipped — you still get the image.

**Alternative LLMs (also free):**
• Groq — fast, free tier
• Ollama — fully local, no API key
• OpenRouter — some free models

### 📥 Intake
Form trigger captures the brief.
Config node loads ALL brand context
so every AI agent references
one source of truth.

### 🧠 Stage 1 — Sofia (Strategy)
AI proposes 3 content angles.
Sofia reviews via HITL form.
✅ Approve → picks an angle → Marcus
🔄 Revise → feedback loops back with notes
❌ Reject → kills the brief cleanly

Feedback is injected into the next AI run
so the output actually improves.

### ✍️ Stage 2 — Marcus (Creative + Image)
AI writes post copy + image direction.
🖼️ Pollinations.ai generates the actual image
from the AI's visual description — no API key!
Marcus reviews text AND the generated image.
✅ Approve → Taylor
🔄 Revise → feedback loop regenerates both

### ✅ Stage 3 — Taylor (Final QA)
AI summarises the post, flags issues,
gives a recommendation.
Taylor makes the final call:
✅ Approve → video is created → publish
🔄 Back to Marcus → revision notes
❌ Reject to Sofia → restart angles

Taylor's feedback reaches the RIGHT
stage — not just a generic retry.

### 🎬 Media Output
After Taylor approves:
1. FFmpeg creates a 15s
   video from the generated
   image (Ken Burns zoom
   + fade transitions)
2. Final Output logs
   post + image + video

Replace with Google Sheet,
Slack, or any destination.

### 💡 Tips for Scoring Higher

• **HITL Design (40%)** — Every rejection feeds specific notes back to the AI. The prompt changes on retry. 4 feedback loops total.
• **Quality & Client Fit (30%)** — Brand guide + platform playbook in Config. AI agents reference them. Image generated on-brand.
• **Workflow Efficiency (15%)** — Config is single source of truth. Swap clients by editing one node. Image/video auto-sized per platform.
• **AI Usage (10%)** — Prompts are role-specific with full context. Temperature tuned per role. Feedback-aware.
• **Creativity (5%)** — Actual image generation via Pollinations. Video creation via FFmpeg. Taylor has 3-way routing. AI pre-flags issues.

=## Content Brief
- **Client:** {{ $json.client }}
- **Platform:** {{ $json.platform }}
- **Content Type:** {{ $json.content_type }}
- **Topic Hint:** {{ $json.topic_hint }}
- **Tone Note:** {{ $json.tone_note }}

## Your Task
Research the topic and propose exactly **3 distinct content angle options** for this brief.

For each angle, provide:
1. **Angle Title** — a short, clear name
2. **Hook** — the opening line or question that would grab the audience
3. **Rationale** — 2-3 sentences on why this angle fits the client's brand, audience, and platform
4. **Content Direction** — brief outline of what the post would cover

Make sure your angles are:
- Distinct from each other (not variations of the same idea)
- Aligned with the brand voice and platform tone
- Appropriate for the {{ $json.platform }} audience
- Relevant to the "{{ $json.content_type }}" format
- Grounded in a real insight, data point, or trend — not generic advice

{{ $json.lastFeedback ? '## REVISION REQUESTED\nYour previous angles were rejected by the strategist. Here is their feedback:\n\n> ' + $json.lastFeedback + '\n\nAddress this feedback directly. Do NOT repeat the same type of angles. Show that you understood the note and adjusted your approach.' : '' }}

Format your response clearly with headers for each angle. Number them 1, 2, 3.

parameters.content:
### 🖼️ Image Generation Pipeline

**Code node** parses Marcus's AI output
and extracts the IMAGE DIRECTION section.

**Pollinations.ai** generates the actual
image from that description — completely
free, no API key, no signup.

Image dimensions auto-adjust:
• LinkedIn: 1200x627
• X: 1200x675
• Instagram: 1080x1080

Marcus reviews the real image in his form.

parameters.text:
=## Post to Review

{{ $('Marcus — AI Agent').item.json.output }}

---

**Generated Image URL:** {{ $('Parse & Generate Image URL').item.json.image_url }}
(The image was generated by AI based on Marcus's image direction)

---

## Original Brief
- **Client:** {{ $('Config — Brand + Brief').item.json.client }}
- **Platform:** {{ $('Config — Brand + Brief').item.json.platform }}
- **Content Type:** {{ $('Config — Brand + Brief').item.json.content_type }}
- **Topic Hint:** {{ $('Config — Brand + Brief').item.json.topic_hint }}
- **Tone Note:** {{ $('Config — Brand + Brief').item.json.tone_note }}

## Your Task
Perform a final quality review of this post before it goes live.

### 1. Post Summary
2-3 sentences: what does the post say and what is it trying to achieve?

### 2. Quality Flags
Check against these criteria and flag issues:
- **Character count** — Within optimal range for {{ $('Config — Brand + Brief').item.json.platform }}?
- **Brand voice** — Matches the client's voice and personality? Any off-brand language?
- **Platform fit** — Correct format, hashtag count, structure?
- **Audience relevance** — Will the target audience care? Does the hook work?
- **Language avoid list** — Any banned phrases that slipped through?
- **Image direction** — Is it specific, on-brand, and will the generated image work?
- **Content type match** — Does the post deliver on the requested content type?

List each issue as a short, actionable flag. If no issues: "No flags — post is clean."

### 3. AI Recommendation
Recommend one of:
- **APPROVE** — Post is ready to publish. Say why.
- **BACK TO MARCUS** — Needs creative revisions. Specify what.
- **REJECT TO SOFIA** — Angle is wrong. Explain why new angles are needed.

Be honest and specific. Taylor makes the final call, your recommendation should be well-reasoned.
